scenario: adversarial review of project-settings-trust (not a scripted scenario)
title: kiln -c hangs after a -p run was killed mid-tool
observed: Reported by the adversarial review of branch project-settings-trust: after a 'kiln -p' run is killed while a tool call is in progress, a following 'kiln -c' (continue the latest session) hangs. Not reproduced by the agent that recorded this finding.
expected: kiln -c resumes the interrupted session (finishing or discarding the incomplete operation) and reaches the prompt.
evidence: Reviewer report only; no repro steps or logs captured yet.

fix.note: Root cause: the TUI ran agent.ResumeIncomplete synchronously in cli/tui.go before program.Run(); Lane.Resume re-executes the interrupted tool, whose lifecycle events reach the UI via Bridge.Send -> tea.Program.Send, which blocks until the event loop drains its channel — which only starts at program.Run(). So the first resumed tool event deadlocked and --continue hung on a blank screen (goroutine dump: Program.Send at tea.go:1196 <- beginTool <- Lane.Resume <- ResumeIncomplete <- RunInteractive). Fix: tui.Model.startResume dispatches Lane.Resume as a tea.Cmd after the banner commits (mirroring beginTurn), so it runs off the Update goroutine with the loop live; print mode still calls agent.ResumeIncomplete directly, which is correct there (no event loop).
